summary: Account is brand new (10 IG, 1 LI, 1 BS followers). IG reels lose 77% viewers in first 3s — hook failure. Only 1 chatbot post got traction (12 engagements). Bio violates rules: niche/region targeting, 24hr promise, free audit offer. No meaningful pattern yet — too few posts.
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: **Question** (only style with proven engagement: "Your customers ask the same 5 questions..."). Avoid Curiosity and Contrast — both scored 0.
- Topics to avoid repeating: "Static vs Motion", "Missing Website Trust Gap" — already posted, no engagement.
- Posts must read as a developer showing real work, never an ad. No demos, no free audits, no niche targeting.
- Use national hashtags only (#SmallBusinessIndia #FreelanceIndia #AIChatbot).
- Lead with the problem, not the service.

instructions.research: Find 3 real questions small Indian businesses (cafe, clinic, gym, shop, coaching) get daily on WhatsApp/Instagram DM. Quote them verbatim. No made-up examples.
instructions.analysis: Compare the chatbot post that got 12 engagements vs the 0-engagement posts. Note: it used a Question hook, plain chat-card image, no video. Replicate that format.
instructions.writer: Write a Question-hook post: "Your customers ask the same 5 questions every day. Your phone doesn't." List 3 generic example questions (e.g. 'Price?', 'Timings?', 'Location?'). End with: "Pay after approval. DM for honest advice if a chatbot fits." No demo offer.
instructions.image: Create a simple chat-card graphic: 3 bubbles showing example questions. Clean, developer-style, no branding. Text readable on mobile. No 'demo' or 'sample' labels.
instructions.video: Do not produce video today. Reels skip rate 77% — hook not fixed. Focus on static image post that already worked.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: 'AI chatbots, animated ads, lead gen & websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice.' Remove niche, region, timeframe, free audit.
Comment on 5 posts by Indian small business owners (cafe, clinic, gym, shop, coaching) discussing customer queries or WhatsApp overload. Add value, don't pitch.
Reply to the 1 comment on your chatbot post (if any) with a genuine follow-up question about their FAQ volume.

weak_signals.detail: reels lose 77% of viewers in the first 3 seconds across 1 reels: the hook is not stopping the scroll
the last 5 settled posts got zero likes, comments, shares and saves
4 posts in 7 days and followers changed by +0
